reasoning_content: The issue is `implementation project(':capacitor-android')` - that project doesn't exist. We need to either include the capacitor android module or change this to use the published artifact. Let me fix this.

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Update app build.gradle - use artifact instead of project
new_deps = '''dependencies {
    implementation 'androidx.appcompat:appcompat:1.6.1'
    implementation 'androidx.core:core-ktx:1.12.0'
    implementation 'androidx.activity:activity:1.8.2'
    implementation 'com.google.android.material:material:1.11.0'
    implementation 'androidx.multidex:multidex:2.0.1'
    implementation 'com.getcapacitor:android:5.7.0'
}'''

# Replace dependencies section
c.exec_command("""sed -i '/dependencies {/,/^}/c\\""" + new_deps.replace('\n', '\\n') + """' /opt/areloria/client/android/app/build.gradle""")

# Also need to add capacitor plugin to settings
c.exec_command("""echo 'pluginManagement {
    repositories {
        google()
        mavenCentral()
        gradlePluginPortal()
    }
}
include ":app"
project(":app").projectDir = new File("app")
' > /opt/areloria/client/android/settings.gradle""")

print("Fixed dependencies!")

c.close()
EOF
